text:
Nico (SRE): Heads-up: starting ~08:00 UTC we're seeing model load failures for new container starts in eu-west-2. Error: failed to fetch artifact from object-store with 504/timeout. Spike in cold-start errors.

S3Bot: [ALERT] object-store: high 5xx rate for bucket redwood-model-artifacts-eu-west-2. Auto-incident INC-2025-101 created.

Dana (Model Ops): Confirmed. Several model-serving pods failed startup due to missing artifact tarballs. Requests that hit empty caches are getting 502s or long startup tail latency.

Ibrahim (Storage Eng): We're seeing sustained replication lag between primary s3-cluster and eu-west replica region. Head-object latency high and some GETs timing out around 07:54 UTC. Investigating control-plane throttles.

Nico (SRE): Scope: impacts new instance cold-starts and autoscaled replicas only. Warm replicas with cached artifacts still serving. Affected customers: some Dedicated and PLG tenants in eu-west-2 during burst scaling.

Dana (Model Ops): Immediate mitigation options: 1) fail open to serve from fallback cached layers, 2) redirect new replica pulls to us-east mirror, 3) pre-warm popular models in eu-west local cache. I'm running pre-warm for top 10 models now.

Ibrahim (Storage Eng): Root cause provisional: control-plane metadata write queue backed up due to transient DB maintenance, causing replication controller to stall artifact propagation. Also observed increased 429s from signing-service. Working on unblocking DB maintenance tasks.

Nico (SRE): Mitigations executed:
```
# force fallback registry to serve from regional mirror
kubectl -n model-registry patch configmap registry-config -p '{"data":{"primary_bucket":"s3://redwood-model-artifacts-us-east-1"}}'
# pre-warm caches for hot models
infractl prewarm-cache --region=eu-west-2 --model-list=top10
```

Dana (Model Ops): After forcing mirror and pre-warm we see cold-start failures drop ~90% within 8 minutes. Autoscaler able to spin up replicas that successfully load artifacts from fallback mirror.

StatusPage Bot: Posted initial status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-101 1: Partial degradation for model deployments in eu-west-2. Some cold-starts failing; warm instances unaffected.

Hannah (Customer Success): CS update drafted and sent to impacted tenants: "We're experiencing delayed model startup in eu-west-2 due to artifact propagation issues. We've applied a regional fallback and are pre-warming top models. We'll update by 09:30 UTC."

Ibrahim (Storage Eng): Control-plane backlog cleared at 08:40 UTC after removing maintenance lock and scaling metadata DB to handle catch-up. Signing-service backoff fixed. Replication lag returning to normal gradually.

Nico (SRE): Current status: mitigated for customer traffic  artifact fetch errors near baseline and cold-start success rate restored to ~98%. Keeping channel open for 1h monitoring window.

Dana (Model Ops): Follow-ups: 1) postmortem and timeline (Dana + Ibrahim + Nico), 2) add alert for artifact replication lag > 30s, 3) add automated fallback to regional mirror when replication lag detected, 4) change prewarm strategy to proactively warm most-used models during expected traffic spikes.

Ibrahim (Storage Eng): Also adding retry/backoff improvements to signing-service and an automated maintenance guard that prevents control-plane maintenance from starting without an approved drain window.

Nico (SRE): Incident resolved for now  monitoring window active. If you see regressions ping @oncall immediately. :white_check_mark:
